sophie (PM): Quick thread to capture outstanding launch constraints for GA doc we'll share with execs. Need clarity on SLA penalties, telemetry retention, support TTR promises, and canary rollback thresholds.
ricardo (Eng): Implementation reality: we can set a per-route p95 SLA and a global uptime target. Automatic rollback on error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5m is doable. Also can gate model-promote by synthetic-test pass rate.
tara (Legal): SLA penalties: we prefer credit-only remedies capped to monthly bill for affected service, not unlimited. Also want a force-majeure clause covering region outages. Need clear definition of "service unavailability" (5xx + timed-out streaming), and the measurement window.
mina (Support): For GA support promises, proposal: first-response within 1 hour for P1 during business hours, 3 hours off-hours. TTR (time-to-resolution) depends a lot on SRE availability. We should avoid hard resolution SLAs for first 30 days.
evan (SRE): Telemetry retention request: ops needs 90 days of raw traces and 365 days of alert/incident metadata for postmortem correlation. Storage cost estimate: ~0.6% increase in infra spend at current traffic. Also: run synthetics every 1m from 3 regions to detect regional regressions.
sophie (PM): To summarize a proposed baseline for the GA handout: SLA: p95 latency target per-route (hosted) = 350ms, availability objective = 99.9% measured monthly, remedies = billing credits capped at impacted-month invoice. Telemetry retention = 90d traces, 365d incidents. Support: first-response 1h biz / 3h off. Canary: auto-roll back if error-rate >0.5% for 5m or p95 latency degrades by >2x. Pricing: indicate "indicative" self-serve rates; committed enterprise pricing behind contracts.
ricardo (Eng): Small ask: we need to freeze the SDK surface for GA. Breaking changes post-GA complicate SLAs. Can we mark SDK as "v1" and route bug-critical patches as semver-patch-only?
tara (Legal): Agree on v1 freeze. Also require a 30-day notice for breaking API changes in contract language.
mina (Support): Can we include a short runbook excerpt in public docs for common customer issues (auth, throttling, billing)? That reduces first-response load. Two-page excerpt should be fine.
evan (SRE): Additions to alerts: 1) synthetic failure across >1 region; 2) total 5xx >0.2% 10m; 3) cache eviction churn >15% 15m. Also implement an automated "fallback to lighter model" policy for overload scenarios.
pricing-bot: pricing: flagged enterprise-quote templates missing test cases. Recommend run billing end-to-end for both metered and committed flows before public pricing.
sophie (PM): Decision check: anyone blocking the baseline I just wrote? If not I'll lock it and prep the GA one-pager.
tara (Legal): Not blocking but need the exact "service unavailability" metric wording to approve. I'll draft suggested wording and post in this thread.
ricardo (Eng): Not blocking. I'll open PRs: SDK freeze + canary rollback automation + synthetic checks. ETA 2 days.
evan (SRE): Not blocking. I'll share retention cost calc and alert dashboards by EOD tomorrow.
mina (Support): Not blocking. I'll draft the 2-page public runbook excerpt and sample support templates. ETA EOD today.
sophie (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll produce the GA one-pager with these items and add a "known unknowns" section: billing E2E tests, legal SLA wording, and SDK edgecase fixes. Ping here when drafts are up. :rocket:
